mapper.select: select r.req_id, r.doc_id, r.lin_id, r.ori_emp_id, r.new_emp_id, r.req_emp_id, r.req_reason, r.req_status, r.created_at, d.doc_title as docTitle, eo.emp_name as oriEmpName, en.emp_name as newEmpName, er.emp_name as reqEmpName from appr_line_request r join appr_doc d on r.doc_id = d.doc_id join employee eo on r.ori_emp_id = eo.emp_id left join employee en on r.new_emp_id = en.emp_id join employee er on r.req_emp_id = er.emp_id where r.req_status = 'REQ' order by r.created_at asc
